subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Which path should own the Feishu underscore-URL fix: adopt or refresh a linked fork candidate, permit a new narrow same-repository replacement, or wait for live Feishu proof first?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the issue is already paired with open conflict-marked fork PRs and a no-new-fix-pr label, so automation should not create another branch without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt or refresh a linked candidate
options.body: Use the best existing fork candidate as source, resolve conflicts, require focused Feishu proof, and land through a same-repository PR.

options.title: Allow a new replacement
options.body: Clear the no-new-fix-pr path and let a repair worker create a fresh plugin-local PR with regression tests and source-candidate credit.

options.title: Wait for live Feishu proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or contributor verifies the renderer behavior in a real Feishu tenant and chooses the final normalization shape.

recommendation.title: Adopt or refresh a linked candidate
recommendation.body: Use the best existing fork candidate as source, resolve conflicts, require focused Feishu proof, and land through a same-repository PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path maintenance and release ownership make this the best available routing owner for choosing the fix path.
